prompt: Summarize in one or two sentences: A study found that adults who slept 6 hours or less each night had a 12% higher risk of early death than those who slept 7 to 8 hours. The link remained after adjusting for age, sex, and lifestyle factors, so the authors say sleep duration itself matters, not just health problems.
